commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Partner pair Kraum, Ludevic's Opus ({3}{U}{R} legendary creature with flying and haste; Commander 2016, c16, released 2016-11-11) and Tevesh Szat, Doom of Fools ({4}{B} legendary planeswalker that can be your commander; Commander Legends, cmr, released 2020-11-20); both have Partner. Both commander-legal per live Scryfall, neither a Game Changer, no project exception. The deck ID Grixistax___October_2026 is not a commander name (naming discrepancy recorded); the tracker's 'Kraum, Ludevic's Opus // Tevesh Szat, Doom of Fools' uses ' // ' only as a pair separator. Oracle: Kraum - whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, draw a card. Tevesh - +2: create two 0/1 black Thrull creature tokens; +1: you may sacrifice another creature or planeswalker; if you do, draw two cards, then draw another card if the sacrificed permanent was a commander; -10: gain control of all commanders and put all commanders from the command zone onto the battlefield under your control. Plan (owner 2026-10-14): fast mana into asymmetric-in-practice stax (Winter Orb, Static Orb, Tangle Wire, Contamination, Blood Moon, Back to Basics, Trinisphere, Damping Sphere, Chalice, Torpor Orb, Cursed Totem, Overburden) where Tevesh's Thrulls pay Contamination, Skullclamp, Culling the Weak and Diabolic Intent; wins with Helm of Obedience + Leyline of the Void / Dauthi Voidwalker or Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond / Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze. The candidate adds a commander-independent Faerie stream for the same sacrifice outlets and a colour-correct rock for both commanders.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (rogue/fringe cEDH stax; owner-approved), unchanged. Game Changers: 22 in both baseline and candidate (Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Gamble, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Jeska's Will, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Narset, Parter of Veils, Necropotence, Notion Thief, Opposition Agent, Orcish Bowmasters, Rhystic Study, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). Repo EDHTop16 aggregate has only 7 entries and is not used.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Tevesh's sacrifice/draw Oracle and the stax plan: Bitterblossom feeds Tevesh's +1, Skullclamp and Contamination without Tevesh; Arcane Signet pays both commanders' colours under our own land locks. No turbo card (Thassa's Oracle/Demonic Consultation, Ad Nauseam, rituals beyond Dark Ritual) is added. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the registry Archidekt exports, candidate/baseline): Kefka, Court Mage 68/67; Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh + Silas Renn 65/66; Kess, Dissident Mage 65/65; Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge 64/64. The overlap is the Grixis cEDH staple core (fast mana, tutors, free counters, Underworld Breach). Grixistax-unique against all four in the candidate: Ashiok, Dream Render; Back to Basics; Bitterblossom; Blood Moon; Chalice of the Void; Contamination; Cursed Totem; Cyclonic Rift; Damping Sphere; Helm of Obedience; Karn, the Great Creator; Leyline of the Void; Magus of the Moon; Mana Drain; Narset, Parter of Veils; Notion Thief; Overburden; Sheoldred, the Apocalypse; Skullclamp; Static Orb; Tangle Wire; Torpor Orb; Trinisphere; Winter Orb (plus the two commanders). The swaps lower overlap: Mox Amber is shared with Rograkh/Silas and Windfall with Rograkh/Silas and Kess; Bitterblossom is in none of the four (Arcane Signet is in three). Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Arcane Laboratory and the one-spell-cap class, Black Market Connections, Defense Grid, Grafdigger's Cage, Kederekt Parasite, Nekusar, Phyrexian Tyranny, Psychosis Crawler, Exotic Orchard, Luxury Suite, Training Center, Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, the turbo package, Gilded Drake, Dress Down, Mnemonic Betrayal, The One Ring, Hullbreaker Horror, Stranglehold, Vexing Bauble, Chains of Mephistopheles, Nether Void, Smokestack and broad symmetric taxes) are not re-added.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 98 library cards were reviewed (96 rows plus 1 Island, 1 Mountain, 1 Swamp; 100 distinct names). Owner 2026-10-14 adds: Damping Sphere, Necropotence, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Contamination, Dark Ritual, Force of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Skullclamp, Flooded Strand, Marsh Flats, Arid Mesa, Phyrexian Tower; explicit keeps: Damping Sphere, Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, Back to Basics, Necropotence, Overburden, Tangle Wire, Karn, the Great Creator. Neither cut (Mox Amber, Windfall) is in either set. Candidate roles: 26 lands; 7 creatures (Dauthi Voidwalker, Magus of the Moon, Notion Thief, Opposition Agent, Orcish Bowmasters, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse); 3 planeswalkers (Ashiok, Dream Render; Karn, the Great Creator; Narset, Parter of Veils); 22 artifacts; 10 enchantments (Back to Basics, Bitterblossom, Blood Moon, Contamination, Leyline of the Void, Mystic Remora, Necropotence, Overburden, Rhystic Study, Underworld Breach); 22 instants; 8 sorceries. Stax suite: Winter Orb, Static Orb, Tangle Wire, Trinisphere, Damping Sphere, Chalice of the Void, Torpor Orb, Cursed Totem, Contamination, Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, Back to Basics, Overburden, Leyline of the Void, Narset, Notion Thief, Opposition Agent.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 26 lands unchanged (land colour sources U19/B19/R17 with fetches counted for each colour they can find; colourless-only: Ancient Tomb, Gemstone Caverns). 72 nonland cards; curve MV0 8 -> 7, MV1 18 -> 18, MV2 18 -> 20, MV3 19 -> 18, MV4 8, MV5 1; average nonland MV 2.06 -> 2.07; coloured pips U/B/R 24/26/10 -> 23/27/10. whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Fourteen stack-interaction cards (Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Mana Drain, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, Mindbreak Trap, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat, Chain of Vapor as protection), plus Orcish Bowmasters, Toxic Deluge, Deadly Rollick, Cyclonic Rift, Otawara. Weak to artifact/enchantment removal of the lock pieces and to our own colour starvation; Bitterblossom adds bodies that survive artifact hate (engine online under artifact hate 0.036 -> 0.1071). Cost: blue pitch cards 22 -> 21.

material_candidates.role: {2} artifact: tap for one mana of any colour in your commanders' colour identity (U, B or R for this partner pair).
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Mox Amber is not an owner addition or explicit keep. {0} legendary artifact: tap for one mana of any colour among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control. Its live enablers are only Ragavan, Ashiok, Narset, Sheoldred and the two commanders (Karn is colourless, so a Karn-only board makes no mana; Pass C correction). Bounded goldfish (seed 27, 40000 games): live given deployed only 0.051/0.086/0.173/0.274 on turns 1-4. EDHREC partner cEDH 18/81. Competing cut tested: Overburden (explicit owner keep).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Pays the commanders' coloured costs (Tevesh {4}{B}, Kraum {3}{U}{R}) and the deck's UU spells while Contamination makes every land tap for {B} or Blood Moon makes nonbasics tap for {R}: P(U by turn 4 under Contamination) 0.279 -> 0.330, P(UU) 0.038 -> 0.053; P(UU by turn 4 under Blood Moon) 0.401 -> 0.427. Turns on Mox Opal metalcraft like Amber.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Costs two mana on turn 1-2 where Amber is free: loses the rare turn-1 Ragavan + Amber line. Dies to the same artifact hate. Mean turn-4 mana 3.138 -> 3.193 and P(Tevesh castable turn 4) 0.1526 -> 0.1657. Spellbook 6 -> 6; Game Changers 22 -> 22.
material_candidates.reason: Genuine swap 1: the Pass C requested test, measured better than Amber in every lock state, near-universal partner cEDH adoption (79/81 vs Amber 18/81), and it dominates Talisman of Indulgence. Cut is not an owner card.

material_candidates.role: {1}{B} enchantment — Faerie: at the beginning of your upkeep, lose 1 life and create a 1/1 black Faerie Rogue with flying.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Windfall is not an owner addition or explicit keep. {2}{U} sorcery: each player discards their hand and draws that many cards (the largest number discarded). It refills opponents unless Narset or Notion Thief is on the battlefield (deep-review defect for a stax deck), loses its graveyard value while the owner-added Necropotence is out (Necropotence: whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard, so the discarded hand is no Underworld Breach fuel), and appears in no Commander Spellbook combo in this list (Wheel of Fortune carries 1368-1878-2706 and 1368-2706-3518). Counter-evidence: EDHREC partner cEDH 53/81 (mostly turbo Breach lists). It is one of the deck's 22 blue Force of Will / Force of Negation pitch cards (22 -> 21 in the candidate). Alternative cuts staged: Cyclonic Rift (Game Changer, 50/81) and Magus of the Moon (redundant Moon creature).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Commander-independent fodder for the deck's Tevesh/Thrull sacrifice plan: Tevesh's +1 (sacrifice a creature: draw two), Skullclamp (Faerie becomes 2/0, dies, draw two), Contamination's upkeep sacrifice (order the Bitterblossom trigger first, CR 603.3b), Phyrexian Tower, Culling the Weak, Diabolic Intent and Beseech the Mirror's bargain (Bitterblossom itself or a token). Under Tangle Wire the Faerie taps for the fade cost. Measured (Tevesh needs five mana including {B}): P(token engine online by turn 4) 0.1532 (Tevesh only) -> 0.2309, under Contamination 0.1187 -> 0.2019, Blood Moon 0.1111 -> 0.1807, artifact hate 0.036 -> 0.1071.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: One life per upkeep with Necropotence and Mana Confluence in the deck; a two-mana setup turn. Windfall's partner cEDH adoption is 53/81 while Bitterblossom appears on the solo Tevesh page (40/122) and only 2/19 optimized partner lists; the partner cEDH sample is turbo-dominated. Force pitch blue count 22 -> 21 (colour from Oracle, Pact of Negation blue by colour indicator; P(another blue card with a Force in hand) turn 1 0.7748 -> 0.756). Spellbook 6 -> 6.
material_candidates.reason: Genuine swap 2: makes the stax plan's sacrifice outlets live without Tevesh, measured +7.8 points engine-online by turn 4, and replaces a symmetric refill wheel that is in no combo. Moderate confidence; cut is not an owner card; alternative cuts staged.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Two swaps: +Arcane Signet -Mox Amber trades a free but rarely live Mox for a two-mana rock that makes U/B/R under our own Contamination and Moon locks; +Bitterblossom -Windfall trades a symmetric wheel for a one-sided Faerie stream that feeds Tevesh, Skullclamp and Contamination. Game Changers stay at 22; lands stay at 26; Spellbook combos stay at 6; blue pitch cards 22 -> 21; Bitterblossom costs 1 life per upkeep. Neither cut is an owner addition or explicit keep.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C requested Talisman of Indulgence and Arcane Signet against Mox Amber and a source-paid Overburden/Karn alternative; Talisman and the Overburden cut are staged as complete 100s and rejected. Bitterblossom is staged against Cyclonic Rift and Magus of the Moon; Opposition is staged against Static Orb and Magus of the Moon.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Mox Amber is live in about a quarter of games by turn 4 even when drawn and Karn cannot enable it, while the deck's sacrifice outlets (Tevesh +1, Skullclamp, Contamination, Phyrexian Tower, Culling the Weak) depend on a five-mana planeswalker; Windfall refills opponents in a deck trying to starve them.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Two genuine swaps: +Arcane Signet -Mox Amber (measured, Pass C request, medium-high confidence) and +Bitterblossom -Windfall (measured engine gain, moderate confidence, adoption counter-evidence disclosed). Every other challenger is dominated, self-defeating under our own locks, owner-rejected, off-identity, or not clearly better (Opposition). RESEARCH_ONLY.

withdrawal_reason: RESEARCH_ONLY: two genuine swaps (+Arcane Signet -Mox Amber, +Bitterblossom -Windfall), below the five-swap owner-presentation floor. Pass C's requested tests were run in bounded seeded form: Arcane Signet beats Mox Amber and dominates Talisman of Indulgence; the Overburden competing cut is rejected (owner keep). Opposition is staged but not counted (deployability under our own locks). Every other candidate is dominated in the same slot (Talisman of Indulgence, Fellwar Stone, Spell Pierce, Dispel), self-defeating under our own locks (Strip Mine, Urza's Saga, Null Rod, Stasis), slower (Frozen Aether), not clearly better than an owner addition or incumbent (City of Traitors, Praetor's Grasp, Snuff Out, Undercity Sewers), owner-rejected (Braids, Cabal Minion; Sphere of Resistance class; turbo creatures) or invalid (white hosers off-identity). The five-swap floor is not met without padding. This packet is NOT owner-presentable and NOT owner approved; the canonical Grixistax October 2026 list is unchanged.
